fullContentHtml:
Short Information : Institute Of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) has released a Notification for the recruitment of IBPS RRB Bank Officer Scale-I, II, III Post on the official website of the IBPS. This recruitment has been issued for 13706 posts. Online applying process for IBPS RRB XV 15th Scale-I, II, III Recruitment 2026 has Started from 01 September 2026 &  candidate can apply till 21 September 2026. Candidates must check complete details for IBPS RRB XV 15th Officer Scale-I, II, III Recruitment 2026. 

Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS)

IBPS RRB XV Officer Scale-I, II, III Recruitment 2026

Important Dates

  • Starting Date : 01 September 2026
  • Last Date for Registration : 21 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 21 September 2026
  • PET Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Pre Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Notify Soon
  • Result : Notify Soon

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 850/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 175/-
  • PH : Rs. 175/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

IBPS RRB 15th Notification 2026 : Age Limit

  • Age Limit As On 01 September 2026
  • For Office Assistant : 18-28 Years
  • For Officer Scale-I : 18-30 Years
  • For Officer Scale-II : 21-32 Years
  • For Officer Scale-III : 21-40 Years
  • Age Relaxation as per IBPS RRB 15th Recruitment Rules.

IBPS RRB 15th Recruitment 2026 : Educational Qualification

Post Name Eligibility 
Office Assistant (Multipurpose)
  • Candidates must have completed their Graduation in any discipline from any recognized University/institute will be eligible for this post.
  • Proficiency in local language as prescribed by the participating RRB.
  • Desirable: Working knowledge of Computer.
Officer Scale-I (Assistant Manager)
  • Candidates must have completed their Graduation in any discipline from any recognized University/institute will be eligible for this post.
  • Preference will be given to the candidates having degree in Agriculture, Horticulture, Forestry, Animal Husbandry, Veterinary Science, Agricultural Engineering, Pisciculture, Agricultural Marketing and Cooperation, Information Technology, Management, Law, Economics or Accountancy;
  • Proficiency in local language as prescribed by the participating RRB.
  • Desirable: working knowledge of Computer.
Officer Scale-II (General Banking Officer)
  • Candidates must have completed their Graduation in any discipline with minimum 50% marks from any recognized University/institute will be eligible for this post.
  • Preference will be given to the candidates having degree in Banking, Finance, Marketing, Agriculture, Horticulture, Forestry, Animal Husbandry, Veterinary Science, Agricultural Engineering, Pisciculture, Agricultural Marketing and Cooperation, Information Technology, Management, Law, Economics and Accountancy.
  • 2 years experience as an officer in a Bank or Financial Institution.
Officer Scale-II (CA)
  • Candidates must have passed CA Exam from ICAI India will be eligible for this post.
  • 1 year experience as a Chartered Accountant.
Officer Scale-II (Law)
  • Candidates must having Degree from a recognized University in Law or its equivalent with a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate will be eligible for this post.
  • 2 years experience as an advocate or should have worked as Law Officer in Banks or Financial Institutions for a period of not less than two years.
Officer Scale-II (Marketing)
  • Candidates having MBA Degree in marketing from a recognized University will be eligible for this post.
  • 1 year experience in the relevant field.
Officer Scale-II (Treasury Manager)
  • Candidates having degree in CA or MBA Degree in Finance from a recognized University will be eligible for this post.
  • 1 year experience in the relevant field.
Officer Scale-II (Agriculture)
  • Candidates having Graduation Degree in agriculture / Horticulture / dairy / animal / Veterinary Science / Engineering / Pisciculture from Recognized university / Institute with will be eligible for this post.
  • 2 Years experience in the relevant field.
Officer Scale-II (IT)
  • Candidates must having Graduation Degree in Electronics / Communications / Computer science / Information Technology with Minimum 50% Marks from any recognized University / Institute will be eligible for this post.
  • Desirable: Certificate in ASP, PHP, C++, Java, VB, VC, OCP etc.
  • 1 year experience in the relevant field.
Officer Scale-III (Senior Manager)
  • Candidates having Bachelor’s degree in any discipline from a recognized University or its equivalent with a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate. Preference will be given to the candidates having Degree/ Diploma in Banking, Finance, Marketing, Agriculture, Horticulture, Forestry, Animal Husbandry, Veterinary Science, Agricultural Engineering, Pisciculture, Agricultural Marketing and Co-operation, Information Technology, Management, Law, Economics and Accountancy.
  • Minimum 5 years’ experience as an Officer in a Bank or Financial Institutions.

IBPS RRB 15th Online Form 2026 : Mode of Selection

  • Online Pre Exam
  • Online Mains Exam
  • Interview
  • Document Verification

IBPS RRB XV Officer Scale-I, II, III Online Form 2026 : How To Apply 

  • Candidates can apply through link https://www.ibps.in/ or provided below in link section or they can also apply through official site of the IBPS before Last Date.
  • You Can Check other  Notification Here – 
  • For all the interested and eligible candidates who want to apply for IBPS RRB 15th recruitment can read all the information related to the recruitment is given below and the link to apply is given in the Important Link section below.
